decryptOnly.name: ephemeral-non-canonical-u-accepted
decryptOnly.note: E encodes u = p + 9 (non-canonical, top bit clear). Per RFC 7748 the reader reduces it mod p, so S = X25519(priv_r, 9). The HKDF salt uses the 32 transmitted bytes. MUST decrypt.
